title: advanced-visibility-overview.html
content: Advanced Visibility allows Event Organizers to leverage {{variable.Object_Contact}} or {{variable.Object_PersonAccount}} * data to restrict visibility within the {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} or an authenticated iframe. The feature uses rules with specific criteria to determine who can see and register for {{variable.Object_Event}} s, {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s, and {{variable.Object_Session}} s. In tandem with Express Registration, Advanced Visibility helps {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s find and register for relevant {{variable.Object_Event}} s faster. {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} users can experience Advanced Visibility in the following ways. An authenticated {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} user has a {{variable.Object_Contact}} (or {{variable.Object_PersonAccount}} ) record with information that is relevant to that user. The user can only see the {{variable.Object_Event}} s, {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s, and {{variable.Object_Session}} s that meet the visibility rules’ criteria set by the Event Organizer. An authenticated {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} user can register a household member for an {{variable.Object_Event}} using Express Registration. Visibility rules will restrict a household member’s eligibility based on their {{variable.Object_Contact}} record, preventing the {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} user from registering them for an {{variable.Object_Event}} , {{variable.Object_EventItem}} , and {{variable.Object_Session}} they do not qualify for. When Express Registration is enabled, users will see all {{variable.Object_Event}} s, {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s, and {{variable.Object_Session}} s that meet the visibility criteria for at least one person in their {{variable.Object_Account}} . An Event Organizer with admin-level technical capabilities can also restrict the visibility of {{variable.Object_Event}} s based on standard and custom {{variable.Object_Contact}} record fields on their {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} site. *Salesforce {{variable.Object_PersonAccount}} s are mainly used by nonprofits and higher education. Learn more . Prerequisites Caching 2.0 must be enabled to use Advanced Visibility. Contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} to activate Advanced Visibility and Caching 2.0. Blackthorn Base must have Version 1.42 or higher installed to use Advanced Visibility. All {{variable.Object_Contact}} s you plan to use with Advanced Visibility must be converted to customer contacts. Click here for the steps to complete that process. Early Access Update Thank you for trying our exciting new Advanced Visibility feature! We're thrilled to offer you early access to this powerful tool, and we appreciate your participation as we continue to enhance it for general availability. While our Quality Assurance team has thoroughly tested the feature, its complexity means new insights and gaps may emerge as we explore its full potential across various customer environments and automations. Your feedback will help us make it even better! Below are a few known limitations to keep in mind during this early access phase. Each org can have up to 300 BT Rules at any given time. Each BT Rule can include up to 25 BT Rule Conditions. Using {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtVisibilityAcct}} is not recommended for organizations with more than 1,000 Contacts in a single Account. Events, Event Items, and Sessions can use either Advanced Visibility or Visibility Controls*, not both, except where an Advanced Visibility BT Rule record references a Visibility Control picklist within its criteria. If a Contact is selected from the Express Registration picklist and does not have a value in all fields that are required for registration, the user cannot proceed with registration or fill in the required field. While we prioritize resolving critical issues, in rare cases, we might recommend temporarily disabling Advanced Visibility if it significantly impacts your business operations. Bugs related to this feature will not be resolved as quickly as bugs related to our generally available features. Rest assured, we are committed to making this feature as seamless and robust as possible. *Visibility Control refers to our existing, simpler feature that matches a picklist value on the Event, Event Item, or Session against a picklist value on a Lead or Contact. Please see our documentation for more details. Benefits Event Organizers now have granular control over who sees and registers for {{variable.Object_Event}} s! This is especially important for Event Organizers who maintain ongoing relationships with {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who register through an {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} site or authenticated iframe environment. Flexible Rule Creation: Creates different rules for each {{variable.Object_Event}} , a single rule for multiple {{variable.Object_Event}} s, or any combination. Automated Updates: Updates to {{variable.Object_Contact}} s or {{variable.Object_PersonAccount}} s automatically trigger visibility and access to be re-evaluated. Comprehensive Criteria: Reference any {{variable.Object_Contact}} or {{variable.Object_PersonAccount}} record field. Customizable Eligibility: Tailor your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s’ visibility experiences with options like {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtVisibilityAcct}} and {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtEligibilitAcct}} . Compatibility with Visibility Controls: Seamlessly integrate Advanced Visibility with existing Visibility Controls, allowing for flexible configurations. User Stories Reunion Weekend: Alumni can easily find gatherings relevant to their graduation year and major. Extend visibility to spouses using the {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtVisibilityAcct}} option. After-school Enrichment Classes: Parents can find classes matching their child’s age and school district. Members-only Night: Ensure only active members of a club chapter can access exclusive events. University Information Sessions: High school seniors can see all events for high school seniors who reside in a specific city and are interested in a particular college/school. Or high school seniors can see all events for legacy students. {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} User: When users log in, they will only see the {{variable.Object_Event}} s, {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s, and {{variable.Object_Session}} s that match their custom fields/criteria, so they don’t have to sift through everything. Sponsors: Sponsors at different levels can see the {{variable.Object_Event}} s, Tickets, and activities (Sessions) that apply to their sponsorship level. Regional Leaders: At a leadership council retreat, leadership council members will only see {{variable.Object_Event}} s relevant to their region, so they can register only for the {{variable.Object_Event}} s for which they are eligible. How Advanced Visibility Works with Visibility Controls No Migration Required: Switch to Advanced Visibility for future {{variable.Object_Event}} s without migrating existing ones. It’s as easy as adding a {{variable.Object_BTRule}} to the {{variable.Field_Event_VisibilityRule}} field instead of configuring the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VisibilityContro}} field. You can also combine Visibility Controls with your {{variable.Object_BTRule}} s. Mutually Exclusive Usage: Each {{variable.Object_Event}} , {{variable.Object_EventItem}} , and {{variable.Object_Session}} can reference either an Advanced Visibility Rule, Visibility Controls, or a combination of both. Daily or weekly {{variable.Object_Event}} s use Visibility Controls; the annual {{variable.Object_Event}} will use Advanced Visibility Rules. {{variable.Object_Event}} s use Advanced Visibility for complex criteria; {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s are gated by Visibility Controls for VIP, Member, and Non-Member pricing. Organization-wide usage of one or the other. Referencing Visibility Controls: Advanced Visibility Rules can reference Visibility Controls for additional criteria without rewriting existing automation. How Advanced Visibility Works with Express Registration If you enable Express Registration for your {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} site, Advanced Visibility will optimize your site for visitors browsing for their entire {{variable.Object_Account}} . (This is also true for Visibility Control.) If any {{variable.Object_Contact}} within the logged-in user’s {{variable.Object_Account}} can see an {{variable.Object_Event}} , {{variable.Object_EventItem}} , and {{variable.Object_Session}} , the user will be able to see that option. Express Registration is not the best choice for organizations that prioritize helping {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s find {{variable.Object_Event}} s that are most relevant to them over the speed of group registration. Limitations and Dependencies Does your org have the BT Rule Condition’s Rule (Managed) field? A BT Rule Condition cannot be saved to a BT Rule if the BT Rule Condition’s Rule (Managed) field is in your org. If you try to save a BT Rule Condition while the field exists in the org, you will get an error message. To solve the issue, you must delete the BT Rule Condition’s Rule (Managed) field from your org in Salesforce Classic. Blackthorn cannot delete the field because the field cannot be deleted from Salesforce Lightning Experience. Limitations Advanced Visibility is only available for {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s logged into an {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} site or authenticated iframe environment. There are limits to the number of active {{variable.Object_BTRule}} s and {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} s in an org. Each org can have up to 300 {{variable.Object_BTRule}} s at any given time. Each {{variable.Object_BTRule}} can include up to 25 {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} s. Formula fields are not supported. Dependencies Requires authentication via {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} or an authenticated iframe. Express Registration must be enabled to use the {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtVisibilityAcct}} and {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtEligibilitAcct}} functionality. Please Be Aware Salesforce Admins will see two new remote sites, Blackthorn_DP_Production and Blackthorn_DP_Staging, added to persist Event data in our upcoming Data Persistence architecture. Please note that no personally identifiable information will be persisted. Updates to Permission Sets The Blackthorn | Events (Admin) permission set was updated to include access to {{variable.Object_BTRule}} and {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} objects and their fields. The following fields are added automatically to the {{variable.Object_BTRule}} object page layout. {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtVisibilityAcct}} {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtEligibilitAcct}} {{variable.Field_BTRule_Active}} The following fields were removed from the {{variable.Object_BTRule}} object page layout. {{variable.Field_BTRule_ExtContVisibiAcct}} (deprecated) {{variable.Field_BTRule_VisibilityOption}} {{variable.Field_BTRule_ConditionType}} (Conditions) {{variable.Field_BTRule_CustomFilterLogic}} Updated to the {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} object’s page layout. Added the following fields to the page layout: {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Rule}} , {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Value}} , {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Field}} , {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Order}} , and {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Operator}} . Set the following fields as Read-Only: {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Rule}} , {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Value}} , {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Field}} , {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Order}} , and {{variable.Field_BTRuleCondition_Operator}} . {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} users with the {{variable.PS_ET_CommunityPlatformUser}} permission set can configure and create Advanced Visibility rules and settings, including creating, editing, and deleting {{variable.Object_BTRule}} s and {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} s. New Batch/Apex Job FilterRecordsSyncBatch processes {{variable.Object_Contact}} s, {{variable.Object_BTRule}} s, and {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} s in batches of 1000. Only those {{variable.Object_Contact}} s with {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} site access, plus anyone on the same {{variable.Object_Account}} , will be included in the query results. Any of these three scenarios triggers the batch process A {{variable.Object_BTRule}} is created, updated, or deleted. A {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} is created, updated, or deleted. A {{variable.Object_Contact}} is deleted. Every 24 hours, all {{variable.Object_Contact}} data referenced in {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} s are reevaluated, and fresh visibility data is pushed to the webapp. Custom Settings - Blackthorn Base Settings The Last_FilterRecordsSyncBatch_Start_Time__c field was added to the Custom Settings' Blackthorn | Base Setting. New Scheduled Job Job Name: Blackthorn | Base Adv Visibility Hourly Sync Apex Class: FilterRecordsSyncBatch To activate this scheduled job, set the {{variable.Object_BTRule}} ’s {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} field to "True" (checked) and the {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} field to the current date and time. The job will now run once an hour. Going forward, when a user creates or updates a {{variable.Object_BTRule}} or {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} record, the job will check the date/time in the {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} field, looking for records with a {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} after the scheduled job's start date/time. If the {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} is before the scheduled job's start date, the {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} field will be set to "False." NOTE: Setting {{variable.Object_BTRule}} {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} = "True" (checked) will not cause the {{variable.Object_BTRule}} to be processed immediately. It will be processed during the next scheduled run. Blackthorn | Events Admin Tab Batch Jobs Tab The Refresh Rules button was added to the Batch Jobs tab to recalculate and refresh all rules for Advanced Visibility. Button: Refresh Rules Functionality: Click Refresh Rule to trigger the FilterRecordsSyncBatch batch job. Description: Recalculate and refresh all rules for Advanced Visibility. Visibility Conditions: The Refresh Rule button will only be visible if Advanced Visibility is enabled. (Contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} if you would like to turn on Advanced Visibility.) If the scheduled job does not exist, it will be scheduled 60 minutes from the {{variable.Object_BTRule}} record change. Schedule Jobs Tab The Schedule Advanced Visibility Jobs button is on the Scheduled Jobs tab in the Blackthorn | Events Admin tab. The button only appears to users with the Blackthorn | Events (Admin) permission set. The Schedule Advanced Visibility Jobs job will only appear on the Blackthorn | Events Admin tab when the {{variable.CS_EnableAdvancedVisibility}} custom setting is set to “True.” Blackthorn | App Admin Tab The Schedule Jobs tab is also located on the Blackthorn | Admin app’s Blackthorn | App Admin tab. Updates to Objects Object: Event The {{variable.Field_Event_VisibilityRule}} field was added to the {{variable.Object_Event}} object and page layout. Field Label: {{variable.Field_Event_VisibilityRule}} API Name: conference360__Visibility_Rule__c Data Type: Lookup(BT Rule) Description: Dictates whether the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can view this {{variable.Object_Event}} . Object: Event Item The {{variable.Field_EventItem_VisibilityRule}} field was added to the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} object and page layout. Field Label: {{variable.Field_EventItem_VisibilityRule}} API Name: conference360__Visibility_Rule__c Data Type: Lookup(BT Rule) Description: Dictates whether the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can view this {{variable.Object_EventItem}} . Object: Session The {{variable.Field_Session_VisibilityRule}} field was added to the {{variable.Object_Session}} object and page layout. Field Label: {{variable.Field_Session_VisibilityRule}} API Name: conference360__Visibility_Rule__c Data Type: Lookup(BT Rule) Description: Dictates whether the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can view this {{variable.Object_Session}} . Dynamic UI Updates The Ticket assignment dropdown on the Ticket selection screen will only be available to eligible {{variable.Object_Contact}} s. For example, only eligible {{variable.Object_Contact}} s for the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} with {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = “Main event ticket” can select that Ticket. The “Someone Else” picklist option will only be visible when the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_DisCheSElse}} field is blank. For example, if the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_DisCheSElse}} checkbox is checked, then the “Someone Else” picklist option is NOT listed as a picklist option, and only eligible {{variable.Object_Contact}} s are listed. Users cannot change an eligible {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s information to a non-eligible {{variable.Object_Contact}} for {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s, such as the “Main event ticket.” This ensures that only eligible {{variable.Object_Contact}} s can enter information when purchasing Tickets for an {{variable.Object_Event}} . If the {{variable.Object_Contact}} does NOT meet the visibility and eligibility criteria, they cannot see the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage (Event URL).
